title: Distilling the Truth
description: Distilling the Truth — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Lieutenant

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Speak with the Townston Lieutenant in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Lieutenant

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Hops to Conclusions

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Speak with the Townston Lieutenant in Townston.

Offer:

OK Dungeon Runner, I'll take care of these FizzStar samples. We need to have them tested and see if they are the real deal. Which, of course, means I have to speak to Audrey and ask her to test them. It should only take me a couple hours to explain that we are not married, I am not her husband and never have been. And then the cats...I'll have to ask how each and every one is doing. That should take about another two hours.

I could really use a pick-me-up myself...not that I would drink anything but Townston's Red Karl brand! Don't give me that suspicious look! In the meantime, could you update the Townston Lieutenant about our progress with the investigation? I would do it myself, but I am really just too tired to make such a long journey.

On a completely unrelated note, why did you bring me 7 samples? Why not just 1?

Turn-in:

Who sent you? Who are you? You can't prove it! I have nothing to hide!!!

Client level range: 3–20
